main_text.head: Amimon fluuius.
Arcadia Peloponnesi regio Achaiam & Elidem excipit.

p.note: Arcades antiquissimi Graeciae populi. Stat. Theb. lib. 4.
p.i: Arcades huic veteres astris, Lunaque priores

l.i: Agmina fida datis, nemorum vos stirpe rigenti
Fama satos, cum prima pedum vestigia tellus
Admirata tulit: nondum arua, domusque nec vrbes,
Connubiisque modus Quercus, Lauriq; ferebant
Cruda puerperia, ac populos vmbrosa creauit
Fraxinus, & fœtâ viridis puer excidit orno.
Hi lucis stupuisse vices, noctisque feruntur
Nubila, & occiduum longe Titana secuti
Desperasse diem: rarescunt alta colonis

p.note: Manala. Rhipe opp. Strathie op. Enisfe opp. Tegea mons. Cyllene mos. Clyton fl. Laddon fl. Lapia mons. Pheneos lacus. Azan mons. Parrhasium nemus. Nonacris mons. Orchomenos opp. Cynosuraop. Æphyt opp. Erimanthus mons. Stymphalus.
p.i: Manala, Parthenium fugitur nemus, agmina bello

l.i: Rhipeq;, & Stratie, ventosaque donat Enispe.
Non Tegea, non ipsa Deo vacat alite felix
Cyllene: templumque Alea nemorale Minerue.
Et rapidus Cliton, & qui tibi Phythie Laddon,
Pene socer, candensque iugis Lampia nuosis.
Et Pheneos nigro Stygamittere credita diti.
Venit & Idaeis vlulatibus amulus Azan,
Parrhasiique duces, & qua risistis amores
Grata pheretrato Nonacria rura tonanti.
Dines & Orchomenos pecorum, & Cynosura ferarum,
Æphitios idem ardor agros, & Psophida celsam
Vastat, & Herculeo vulgatos robore montes,
Monstri ferumq; Erimanthon, & horrisonu Stymphalo.
Arcades hi gens vna viris, sed dissona cultu
Scinditur,

page.notes: Marginal place-name glosses are set in small type at the left and were transcribed as a block; the verse lines after the first are set with a tail-like ornament in places. Several words in the left margin and the Greek-ornamented initials are uncertain. The verse ends at "Scinditur," with the page continuing on the next leaf.
